hypothesis: The official starter provides a meaningful end-to-end notebook reference and validates metric/output parity.
validation: matched_sanity: full labeled dev; exact official metric
runtime: <1s candidate body on local CPU; remote setup expected ~40s
result: Mean fraction 0.595188; dev absolute error q25=78.25, median=168, q75=279, p90=389.8, mean=201.84. Exact setup block matched starter; 760-row output schema/id/range checks passed.
reflection: This proves the local interface but cannot locate a passage-specific seam. It is eligible only as the first remote reference while structural/sequence candidates continue.
next_decision: Push once with exact --timeout 600, submit completed version, then replace only with a full-dev-stable structural candidate.

hypothesis: Local bge sentence embeddings encode enough authorship/style signal for a one-transition decoder.
validation: development_proxy: full dev plus grouped 3-fold train CV
runtime: 7.84s local H100 embedding for 43,590 units; estimated <250s one-T4 notebook including setup
result: 319/380 exact, MAE 46.66, p90 error 145.1. Grouped folds 86.076/85.305/90.350. Direct local bge boundary ranker only 81.315.
reflection: The sequence-emission mechanism is real and stable, but frozen semantic/style features leave material headroom versus competition-trained lexical routes.
next_decision: Keep as mechanism-distinct fallback and use only if paired error analysis supports a confidence-based fusion.

hypothesis: Sentence-origin margins aggregated under exactly one irreversible transition locate the boundary.
validation: confirmation_proxy: full official dev plus 3 held-out train passage folds
result: 92.1% exact, MAE 18.7; dev error through p90 is zero. Held-out train folds 93.02/94.37/92.67. Word-only 92.87 and char-only 93.11; onset-only classifier ~64.5.
reflection: Cumulative state evidence, not first-sentence onset alone, is the supported causal mechanism. A weak prior is stable; strong prior degrades.
next_decision: Retain as strong alternative and compare paired errors with the higher-scoring local-transition route.

hypothesis: Lossless structural candidates plus a local origin-logit jump and onset score exploit the strongest competition-specific generator seam.
validation: confirmation_proxy: full official dev, late-id 20% train holdout, deterministic dev halves and fraction stress slices
result: 92.9% exact, MAE 15.82, p90 error 0, p95 105.1. Late-id train holdout 92.866; dev halves 93.848/95.552; low/high fraction slices 92.075/97.190.
reflection: Stable +66.05-point gain over baseline and agreement with two distinct sequence routes support a real generator/style transition. The weak slice is uncommon first generated words (77.94).
next_decision: Promote to notebook version 2 after exact setup, output, runtime, and source checks; use Public transfer to test the stated same-distribution boundary.

hypothesis: The 94.615 dev result reflects passage-general style signal rather than dev/source overlap.
validation: confirmation_proxy: frozen 5-fold passage OOF, 3 contiguous-id folds, 5 source-cluster folds
runtime: 49.2s total five-fold CPU; peak RSS 673 MiB
result: Shuffled folds 90.796/92.793/92.599/89.073/91.997; contiguous folds mean/worst 91.499/91.202; source-cluster mean/worst 91.515/89.617. Candidate recall 100%; no exact text/prefix/suffix duplicates.
reflection: Mechanism generalizes, but full dev is +3.164 optimistic and Public 90.86 aligns with OOF. Source leakage and ID drift inside train are not the cause.
next_decision: Prefer the cumulative sequence route as a separate robustness probe because its held-out mean/worst are stronger.

hypothesis: Joint left/right candidate representations can directly distinguish the true seam.
result: Late-id confirmation 91.976; dev exact 86.3%, MAE 30.73. On 45 disagreements classical is better 36 times and pair only 9.
reflection: Direct pair classification lacks cumulative state evidence and is dominated; complementary exact cases lack a validated selector.
next_decision: Retire as standalone and do not fuse without train-only selection evidence.

hypothesis: Train-only caps or confidence-based sequence fallback reduce incumbent catastrophic errors.
validation: confirmation_proxy: outer train OOF selection plus untouched dev/halves
result: Fraction cap hurts OOF -0.412 and dev -0.822. Sequence fallback improves classical meta-OOF +3.051 with all four fold deltas positive, but dev falls 0.158 and one half falls 0.584; dev tail not reliably reduced.
reflection: Fusion is confirmation-unstable and falsified. The disagreement reveals sequence is the stronger OOF paradigm despite slightly lower dev.
next_decision: Submit pure cumulative sequence likelihood as a mechanism-distinct robustness probe, not the fusion.

hypothesis: Refitting the already selected cumulative decoder on 31% more official labels reduces variance without changing the mechanism.
validation: matched_sanity: in-sample dev interface check; selection evidence remains prior train OOF, honest dev and v3 Public
result: Fits 43,040 sentences from 1,601 official labeled passages; changes 20/760 test predictions versus train-only v3, mean changed-distance contribution 6.26 chars over all rows. In-sample dev 100 is not ranking evidence.
reflection: This is a rule-legal final data-coverage refit, not a Public-tuned parameter change. The small prediction delta bounds risk while added labels plausibly improve later-id coverage.
next_decision: Push as version 4, inspect remote self/output parity, and submit once if valid while preserving v3.

hypothesis: Explicit previous/current/next sentence context improves origin emissions before sequence decoding.
validation: confirmation_proxy: 3 passage folds then untouched dev
result: Two-sentence fold mean/worst 87.762/85.829 versus current 93.719/92.264; dev changes 36, improves 8 and harms 28.
reflection: Context channels blur adjacent states and double-count evidence under cumulative decoding; representation is decisively falsified.
next_decision: Retire and retain single-sentence state emissions.

hypothesis: Generative lexical likelihood ratios are more stable than discriminative SVM margins.
validation: confirmation_proxy: 3 passage folds plus full dev
result: Multinomial fold scores 91.124/93.327/91.395, dev 90.540; Bernoulli mean 91.238, dev 90.420. Both have heavier tails than v3.
reflection: Probabilistic emissions are real but dominated and less stable; no remote information gain.

hypothesis: Competition-label adaptation of the permitted encoder learns origin signals beyond sparse lexical emissions.
validation: confirmation_proxy: fixed 15% train hash holdout, paired lexical baseline, untouched dev/halves; independent reproduction
result: Holdout exact 93.33%, MAE 20.28, paired lexical 94.324. Dev 95.160, halves 93.204/97.056. One fixed epoch/config, no retry; 180-word feasibility retains all known truths.
reflection: The +0.233 paired holdout gain is modest but positive and mechanism-distinct; the larger dev gain is discounted for half dispersion. Remote path is feasible and legal using only local bge.
next_decision: Adapt exact full-train implementation to the official GPU notebook, validate test output and remote constraints, then push once while preserving v4.

hypothesis: The fixed fine-tuning mechanism remains strong when trained on all 1,221 train passages and can produce a compliant remote artifact.
validation: confirmation_proxy: honest full dev plus exact output/deployment audit
result: Dev exact 94.47%, MAE 11.916, p95/p99 69/406. Exact adapted local body reproduces validated 760-row candidate CSV; only local model path, cuda:0, train-only fit, 17,951-byte source.
reflection: Full-train result and independent transformers-5.14 audit preserve the holdout mechanism signal. It changes 67/760 rows versus v4 and offers substantial independent information while v4 remains fallback.
next_decision: Push once on NvidiaTeslaT4 with --timeout 600; inspect actual setup, dev, output, runtime before scoring.

hypothesis: Fine-tuned BGE holdout gains are stable to a predeclared second initialization.
validation: confirmation_proxy: same fixed hash holdout, seed 2027 only
result: Seed2027 holdout is only -0.094 from seed2026 with identical 93.33% exact rate; dev is 94.055 versus 95.160, showing larger dev tail variance.
reflection: Holdout mechanism signal is stable; seed2026 dev peak must not be treated as selection evidence. Keep the predeclared seed2026 candidate rather than choosing by dev.
next_decision: Use seed2026 deployment already pushed; assess only its Public transfer.

hypothesis: Adding all official dev labels to the transferred v5 mechanism reduces decision variance.
validation: matched_sanity: output/deployment check only; selection evidence remains v5 holdout/dev/Public
runtime: 24.76s H100 GPU0, 5.052GB; projected 307.7s T4 including setup
result: Fits 43,590 sentences; validated 760-row test output. Changes 8/760 versus v5 local and 64/760 versus sparse v4; every prediction meets sentence-start and >=180-word constraints.
reflection: This is a bounded official-label coverage refit, not a score-selected neural retry. Small changes limit risk and v5 remains preserved.
next_decision: Adapt as version 6, run optional in-sample interface check, and submit once if remote output/runtime pass.

hypothesis: The true boundary is better represented by the neural human-to-machine logit jump than by cumulative machine evidence over the entire suffix.
validation: confirmation_proxy: fixed 15% train hash holdout plus untouched dev, paired same trained model/logits
runtime: 19.05s H100 including unchanged fit; decoder cost negligible
reflection: Concordant gain across the predeclared honest holdout and dev, driven by exact rate and tail reduction, supports a task-decomposition change rather than parameter tuning. Training and deployment remain unchanged.
next_decision: Refit the selected transition decoder on all official labels and push one final version before the operational cutoff while preserving submitted v6.
